source.teamDataNote: The companion fixture freezes card-level assignments using Lahman 1996/1997 team records, the linked TCDB checklist for trade and photo corrections, and seven deliberate checklist exceptions. No TCDB pages are fetched by the generator.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: One VCS Hobby pack with four cards and Series One pack art pending; physical Series One had 18 ten-card packs/box and Update had 24 ten-card packs/box. VCS uses an 18-pack box and one combined #1-450 base pool.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: One 450-card Base ProductSet and two full 450-card Press Proof checklists. Fourteen additional pack insert or insert-parallel checklists. Total 1569 collector entries across 17 ProductSets.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Only the ten base cards verified by the linked TCDB rookie index have RC appended: #166, #361, #364, #377, #379, #380, #384, #388, #394, #396. The Rookies base subset and Rated Rookies insert do not turn other cards into RCs.
decisions.packOdds: Known original series odds are stored at ProductSet level. Press Proofs used different odds in Series One and Update; the complete unified parallels use the Series One rates and equal card odds. Original Update rates remain in set notes. Unknown odds remain null.
decisions.channelExclusives: Long Ball Leaders were Series One Retail, Rocket Launchers Series One Jumbo. Their checklists are retained but are not assigned Hobby pack odds. Dominators and Power Alley odds were unpublished.
decisions.ripkenBookCard: The Only Way I Know #10 was distributed only with a book; its autograph version was also book-only. The collector pack insert checklist has #1-9.
decisions.excluded: Blister-pack information card, book-only Ripken card and autograph, and dealer SAMPLE promos are excluded from the one-pack Hobby draft.
decisions.cleanNames: Display names omit generic Rookie designations and print annotations. The seven checklist cards have the Checklist subset and intentionally blank team. Team pairs on dual-subject cards are preserved.
decisions.releaseSafety: Keep unreleased until images, pricing, insert odds, and channel-specific product configuration are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete #1-450 combined checklist: Series One #1-270 and Update #271-450, each equally available in VCS. Seven named checklist cards belong here.

productSets.name: Press Proofs Silver
productSets.notes: Complete #1-450; PR2000, not serial numbered. Original odds 1:8 Series One and 1:16 Update; unified VCS odds use 1:8 and equal subject odds.

productSets.name: Press Proofs Gold
productSets.derivedVariant: Gold Press Proof; PR500; die cut
productSets.notes: Complete #1-450 die-cut parallel; PR500, not serial numbered. Original odds 1:32 Series One and 1:64 Update; unified VCS odds use 1:32 and equal subject odds.

productSets.name: Rated Rookies
productSets.notes: Series One insert. Rated Rookie is a design designation, not a true RC label.

productSets.name: Diamond Kings
productSets.notes: Series One non-canvas cards serial numbered 00501-10000; 1:45 packs. The first 500 of each subject were Canvas.

productSets.name: Diamond Kings Canvas
productSets.notes: Series One canvas issue, copies 00001-00500; 1:864 packs.

productSets.name: Elite Series
productSets.notes: Series One, SN2500; 1:144 packs. Dealer SAMPLE promo excluded.

productSets.name: Armed and Dangerous
productSets.notes: Series One Hobby exclusive, SN5000; 1:58 packs.

productSets.name: Long Ball Leaders
productSets.notes: Series One Retail exclusive, SN5000; original Retail odds unpublished. Retained for collector completion with no Hobby pack odds.

productSets.name: Rocket Launchers
productSets.notes: Series One Jumbo exclusive, SN5000; original Jumbo odds unpublished. Retained for collector completion with no Hobby pack odds.

productSets.name: Dominators
productSets.notes: Update insert in all pack channels; published odds unknown.

productSets.name: Rookie Diamond Kings
productSets.notes: Update non-canvas cards serial numbered 00501-10000; 1:24 packs. Rookie-themed design does not imply a true RC.

productSets.name: Cal Ripken: The Only Way I Know
productSets.notes: Pack-issued Update #1-9, SN5000; 1:24 packs. Book-only #10 and its separate 2131 signed book copies excluded from pack checklist.

productSets.name: Power Alley
productSets.notes: Update 24-card color-fractured insert: Gold 4 SN1000, Blue 8 SN2000, Green 12 SN4000. Regular cards are numbered 0251 through their color limit; odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Power Alley Die Cuts
productSets.notes: Update die-cut counterparts for all 24 color-fractured subjects. Copies 0001-0250 of each color; odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Franchise Features
productSets.notes: Update Hobby exclusive dual-front cards, SN3000; 1:48 packs. Linked TCDB checklist and BaseballCardPedia numerical list contain 15 subjects; BCP ratio table says 20 in error.
